name: Barrett Price
strengths: Price runs sharp outs and comebacks — sells stems and separates with route detail.
Price tracks the deep ball smoothly and catches away from his frame.
Price wins contested 50-50s by boxing out and fighting for position in the red zone.
weaknesses: Price creates limited yards after contact once secured — more technician than space breaker.
comparison: Price comps to Jordan Addison — 5-11 / 6-0 sudden WR mold; creates with route sharpness, tracks on the perimeter, and turns timing throws into chunk gains.
projection: Price projects as a Year 2–3 perimeter contributor (scout/special teams Year 1). Ceiling: starting outside/slot WR — the Spain Park separator who grows into an SEC perimeter role.
schemeFit: Price fits Faulkner perimeter concepts that reward stem discipline and contested catch toughness.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-08-08 from Hudl sophomore season. Comp size-matched to Jordan Addison band.
insiderNotes: Price is a sudden perimeter receiver who wins with route detail, tracking, and contested catch toughness. Not a pure burner — separates with technique and fights through contact at the catch point.
recruitingStory: Barrett Price is a 2028 Spain Park (AL) WR · Alabama prospect with Florida interest.
angle: Spain Park WR tape: route sharpness + tracking + contested catch.
